description: Pay a DPX invoice by ID. Runs the full oracle gate → compliance screen → settlement flow and returns a receipt. Any agent with the invoice ID can call this — no account, no API key. This is the core agent-to-agent payment primitive: one agent creates an invoice, another pays it.

payer_address.description: Wallet address of the paying agent

sandbox.description: Set false for live execution. Default: true

name: invoice.pay
